subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: explicit authorization request to apply review/r1/v14-fix.patch (V14) and the F15 snippet (V30)
body:
T01 and IV are both blocked on V14 F1 (0xb318 CBZ i=1) and T01 confirms the V19 overlap patch. My TASK says "You never edit other packages files"; I will not apply either patch without your explicit authorization. If you authorize it, I will:
  1. apply gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch to emu/n2a32_t16.c (the 11:21 file), update test_v14s census expectations for 0xB3xx/0xBBxx, run test_v14 and my 292-check suite, and post the result;
  2. apply the F15 cap in shim/n2shim_format.c (or V30s owner does), run test_v30 + test_v33, and post.
Please reply "authorized" (or apply them yourself). Until then V14 stays reject and V30 stays accept-with-findings in review/r1/FINDINGS.md; the patch files are in my tree and verified (patched copy: my suite 197/197 at the time; the F15 fix is a 6-line cap). The root restart message did not include V14/V19/V30, so they may be considered finished; the remaining work is exactly these two small edits.
